description: nf-core/denovotranscript samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.2.1 schemas. Reference-free transcriptome assembly from paired-end bulk RNA-seq.

transcript_length.help: Minimum assembled transcript length to keep.

assemblers.help: Assemblers to run. Trinity alone is the standard choice; adding more multiplies runtime and memory.

busco_lineage.help: BUSCO lineage for assembly completeness. Downloads on demand; leave unset to skip.

pipeline.name: nf-core/denovotranscript
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. sample and fastq_1 are required; the pipeline targets PAIRED-end libraries, so fastq_2 should normally be populated.
pipeline.reference_requirement: The 1.2.1 schema DOES declare genome, fasta and gtf, so passing them will not abort the run — but the assembly itself is reference-free and they are only consulted for optional evaluation. Do not treat a resolved genome as meaningful here.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
This pipeline is for PAIRED-end bulk RNA-seq. A single-end cohort assembles poorly and will not error.
Use rnaseq instead when the organism has a good reference genome — a de novo assembly is strictly worse when a reference exists.
Trinity is memory-hungry. Do not add assemblers casually on a shared cluster.
busco_lineage triggers a download; leave it unset unless completeness scoring is wanted.
notes: Suited to non-model organisms with no reference genome. NExtSEEK holds 507 RNA-seq D.SEQ records, all from organisms that DO have references (human, mouse, NHP), so this would rarely be the right choice for today's data — it is catalogued for users whose organisms lack one.

sources.label: nf-core/denovotranscript nextflow_schema.json @ 1.2.1
sources.notes: Authoritative: no required params beyond input/outdir; genome, fasta and gtf are all declared.

sources.label: nf-core/denovotranscript assets/schema_input.json @ 1.2.1
sources.notes: Authoritative columns: sample and fastq_1 required; fastq_2 optional in schema but expected in practice.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/denovotranscript input samplesheet.

fastq_2.validation_hints: Populate it — this pipeline wants paired reads.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/denovotranscript sheet from a resolved D.SEQ RNA-seq cohort with no usable reference genome.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the user explicitly asks for de novo transcriptome assembly.
population_priority: Confirm the organism genuinely lacks a good reference; otherwise recommend rnaseq.
One row per D.SEQ leaf, paired reads populated.
final_checks: assemblers is a single value unless the user asked otherwise.
